identity_note: Matched Crescendo (crescendo.ai), the San Francisco AI-native contact-center / CX company incubated by General Catalyst, which fits the batch website and the Contact Center sector. Not Crexendo (NASDAQ: CXDO, cloud telecom), Crescendo Lab (Taipei martech), or the Crescendo music-trainer app acquired by Ultimate Guitar.

profile.name: Crescendo
profile.description: AI-native customer experience platform and managed contact center that combines AI agents with human CX specialists (CCaaS, ticketing, QA, workforce management, knowledge) for retail/ecommerce, connected-device and health & wellness brands.
profile.location: San Francisco, CA (HQ); human CX workforce largely offshore via the PartnerHero acquisition; UK/Europe expansion announced April 2026
profile.year_founded: 2024 (per company's own Aug 2026 release; some trackers such as Sacra list 2023)
profile.founder: Co-founders Matt Price, Andy Lee, Anand Chandrasekaran and Slava Zhakov (incubated at General Catalyst). Andy Lee (former Chairman; Alorica founder and Executive Chairman) became CEO in July 2026; Matt Price, founding CEO, moved to Strategic Advisor to the Board.
profile.funding_detail: $50M Series C at a $500M valuation led by General Catalyst with Celesta Capital and Alorica (Oct 2, 2024); CB Insights lists ~$54.5M total raised. No newer round found as of 2026-10-08.
profile.headcount: ~2,000-2,077 (Built In lists 2,077 employees; TrueUp estimates ~2,000); General Catalyst job board shows a stale 1-10 band
profile.past_completed_deals: Acquired PartnerHero (Boise, ID customer-operations/BPO firm), Oct 2, 2024 - added 200+ customers and ~3,000 CX professionals. No acquisitions found since.
profile.open_role: No open roles found as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: One transformative acquisition (2024) · no deals since · new CEO
verdict.detail: Bought PartnerHero in 2024 to fuse AI with a BPO workforce; new CEO Andy Lee (Alorica founder) is the person who would drive any further BPO buys.
